crossRefs.note: But all winged creeping things which have four feet are an abomination to you.

parallels.note: All winged creeping things are unclean to you. They shall not be eaten.

translations.web: But all winged creeping things which have four feet are an abomination to you.
translations.bsb: All other flying insects that have four legs are detestable to you.
translations.kjv: But all other flying creeping things, which have four feet, shall be an abomination
translations.asv: But all winged creeping things, which have four feet, are an abomination unto you.
